execution.explanation: Upon termination, Recipient must return all copies or destroy them at Discloser's option within the stated period, subject to the archival-copy exception.

evidence: Receiving Party therefore agrees that neither it nor its Representatives will at any time make any independent business or personal use of, retain, copy, divulge, disclose, reveal or communicate to any other person or organization (except as expressly authorized in writing by Originating Party, as required to analyze the Business Relationship or as required to fulfill Receiving Party’s obligations to Originating Party) any Confidential Information.
execution.explanation: The at-any-time non-retention rule contains qualified exceptions: retention is permitted when expressly authorized in writing by Originating Party or required to analyze the Business Relationship or fulfill Receiving Party's obligations. The Agreement does not state that a return or destruction eliminates those qualifications.
